reported.title: Pulse length is 2000 ms not 800 ms
reported.description: PULSE_MS is set to 2000, so the injector stays HIGH for 2 s instead of the specified 800 ms.

reported.title: Debounce timer never initialized
reported.description: trigEdge starts at 0, so on the first loop the 25 ms stability check can pass immediately against a stale edge time, allowing an unsettled trigger to fire; trigEdge should be initialized to millis() in setup.

judge_input.spec:
- Trigger on D4 with INPUT_PULLUP (active LOW); mist injector on D9; ready lamp on D12.
- A settled press as short as 30 ms starts an 800 ms HIGH pulse on D9 within 120 ms.
- Retriggers during an active pulse are ignored.
- Debounce the trigger with 25 ms of stability.
- Keep D12 HIGH when idle and LOW while the injector pulse is active.
- Print `mist shots=<n> busy=<0|1>` every 450 ms.
